name: Reverse Grapple
description: The character can execute brawling specialization attacks while grappling/grappled. As part of acore action utilizing their brawling, they can attempt to reverse a grapple they're caught within. The character initiates a grapple check. On success, they choose between escaping or grappling the target. This action can only be taken once eachround.

name: Disarming Attack
description: The next successful strike this turn knocks whatever the target is holding in their hands 10' away in a direction of the character's choosing.

name: Disorienting Strike
description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose their reaction until the end of their next turn. If the target is a size category larger than the character, WIL save to negate.

name: Grappling Attack
description: The next successful strike this turn automatically grapples the target.

name: Knockout
description: The next successful strike this turn causes the target to lose a core action until the end of their next turn, or instead be knocked unconscious if they are below half their maximum HP, their choice of a WIL or HEA save to negate either effect. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect.

name: Launch
description: The character executes an action, launching themselves or another target 20' per rank in any direction, AGI or STR save (target's choice) to negate. If the target is of a similar size or smaller in comparison to the character and grappled, they cannot resist the effect. This ability requires a suitable surface to push off of if used on oneself.

name: Lethal Barrage II
description: For every rank purchased, the character adds 2 damage to all successful strikes this turn.
